flags.description: Must include --help, --json, --text, --agent-info, --limit, --verbose; plus --dry-run if destructive, and --yes exactly when the tool confirms (confirm_protocol, or mutating when absent; discovery revision 13)

exit_codes.description: Codes this tool can return as its OWN outcomes, each with its meaning. Any key outside the vocabulary fails conformance. A pass-through tool lists only its own outcomes here; the command's codes are declared by passes_exit

confirm_protocol.description: true if mutating and honours --yes / the exit-4 confirmation envelope (report 03 Appendix B, restored at discovery revision 13). A mutating tool whose change is named exactly, applied whole or not at all, and shows what it changed declares false, and then needs dry_run true. Absent means: equal to mutating

dry_run.description: true exactly when --dry-run is among the flags (rule 8). Required true for a mutating tool with confirm_protocol false (discovery revision 13). Absent means: --dry-run in flags

probe.description: Arguments for a safe, read-only, fast invocation that the conformance check runs with --json and --text

passes_exit.description: true when the tool runs a command the agent named and returns that command's exit (discovery revision 9). Conformance then also runs it wrapping `sh -c 'exit 42'` (C6). Absent means false

envelopes.description: The exit-4 envelopes this tool can print, by status (discovery revision 10). confirmation_required exactly when the tool confirms (confirm_protocol, or mutating when absent; discovery revision 13); grant_required for a client whose requests an authority brokers (Adele). Conformance C9 checks every exit-4 output against the envelope its status names, and that the status is declared here. Absent means: confirmation_required if the tool confirms, else none

revision.description: Build revision (constitution H8). REQUIRED for the timelike tool itself, where an empty value is a failure
